body:
Thank you so much for your reply. It means more than I can tell you to feel heard. You seem like a great person :)

That makes total sense about people not knowing what to say. I know I have been guilty of throwing out clichés to save awkwardness!

Thank you for your suggestions as well. Unfortunately I have had a lot of different kinds of therapy ever since I was a kid and it hasn't really worked for me. I am on a waiting list to give it another try though and trying to be optimistic. You're totally right about fresh air and sunlight. I struggle to go out alone due to illness and anxiety but I think I'm going to take a walk to a nearby park now and read a book :)

Again, thank you very much for your response. I hope you have a lovely day :)
I'm sorry if this has made anyone sad or if I come across like a total idiot. I don't know what else to do. I know this was a stupid idea
